"''Only the best weapons dealer in this part of the galaxy.|Drell and Kragan Gorr|}} An '''icy asteroid''' was located within an [[asteroid field]]. It had a Type I [[atmosphere]] breathable to multiple [[species]], although its surface was flat and barren with features of [[Water|icy]] rocks. In [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the [[pirate]] [[Kragan Gorr]], leader of the [[Warbird gang]], arranged to meet with the [[Arms dealer|weapons dealer]] [[Sidon Ithano]] on the [[asteroid]] to buy a [[B1's B2-series super battle droid battalion|battalion]] of vintage [[B2-series super battle droid]]s. The two arrived in their respective [[starship]]s, with Gorr accompanied by the pirates [[Valik]] and [[Drell]]. Gorr praised Ithano and sealed their trade deal, unsuccessfully attempting to haggle the [[Weapon|arms]] [[Merchant|dealer]] in the process. The two parties then parted ways, with Gorr's gang subsequently attempting an unsuccessful [[Mutiny on the Colossus|takeover]] of the mobile [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|space station]] ''[[Colossus]]'' with the newly purchased [[battle droid]]s. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:IcyAsteroid-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art for the asteroid by Aaron Pham]] The icy asteroid appeared in "[[The Mutiny]]," the fourteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. Prior to the episode's release on [[January 5]], [[2020]],{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} the asteroid was first included in the official trailer for the season, released via the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[August 14]], [[2019]].{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance}} At least three concept designs for the asteroid and its rock features were completed by [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Aaron Pham]] on [[August 1]], [[2018]].{{SW|url=the-mutiny-concept-art-gallery|text="The Mutiny" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}{{SW|url=the-mutiny-concept-art-gallery|text="The Mutiny" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 9}} Pham aimed to convey a surface of land with monotonous material. Rocks on the asteroid's surface were reused assets from the third episode of the second season, "[[Live Fire]],"{{SW|url=hunt-on-celsor-3-concept-art-gallery|text="Hunt on Celsor 3" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} that were distinguished by changing their base layer, and flat sections were made to look more reflective. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:IcyAsteroid-ConceptArt.jpg|Concept art, Aaron Pham File:IcyAsteroid-ConceptArt2.jpg|Concept layout, Aaron Pham File:IcyAsteroid-ConceptArt3.jpg|Concept layout, Aaron Pham |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified icy asteroid}} *{{Resistance|The Mutiny}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|VcXhx2g64m8|"The Mutiny" Preview | Star Wars Resistance}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-mutiny-episode-guide|text="The Mutiny" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|t-cL93wss5I|Bucket's List: "The Mutiny" – Star Wars Resistance|nolive=1}} *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-mutiny-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 5 Fun Facts from "The Mutiny" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} *{{BustCollectionCite|65|Character}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Asteroids]] [[Category:Type I atmosphere astronomical objects]]
